summary.title: Forest Friends Quest
summary.tagline: A living magical forest that grows with you for years.
summary.launchShape: 10 regions, 6 guide companions, 50 missions, 3 age tiers

characters.name: Pip
characters.blurb: Curious, brave, and always the first friend explorers meet. Pip knows every shortcut through the Whispering Meadow and never turns down an adventure.

lines.greeting: Hey explorer! I spotted a fresh trail and I think we can solve it together.
lines.hint: Search for the clue that glows, shines, or helps a forest friend travel safely.
lines.cheer: Yip yip! That was a brilliant and brave forest discovery.

characters.name: Mimi
characters.blurb: A tiny singer with a huge heart. Mimi hums the answer into melodies and always knows which path feels right by the rhythm of the forest.

lines.greeting: Tweet tweet! I can sing you a clue whenever you need a little boost.
lines.hint: Listen to the pattern. The forest always hums the answer softly.
lines.cheer: Flap flap! That answer sparkled in exactly the right way.

characters.name: Tomo
characters.blurb: Slow and steady and wise as the oldest stone. Tomo guides explorers through tricky path puzzles one careful step at a time.

lines.greeting: Hello, friend. We can solve this one safe step at a time.
lines.hint: Follow the calm route and trust the order without rushing.
lines.cheer: Steady choices make the strongest explorers. Wonderful work.

characters.name: Luma
characters.blurb: A glowing wonder who lights up memory patterns and celebrates every win with a miniature light show that fills the hollow.

lines.greeting: Sparkle time! I can flash a pattern for you whenever you are ready.
lines.hint: Watch the order carefully. The same lights repeat in a gentle rhythm.
lines.cheer: Sparkle burst! You earned a shiny new forest reward.

characters.name: Nori
characters.blurb: Graceful and gentle, Nori guards the ancient groves and knows the secret language of the deer paths. She only reveals hidden trails to explorers she truly trusts.

lines.greeting: Step softly, dear explorer. The grove has something wonderful to show you today.
lines.hint: Ancient paths leave traces. Look for the mark the deer left behind.
lines.cheer: The forest bows to you. That was a truly graceful discovery.

characters.name: Sol
characters.blurb: Ancient, knowing, and keeper of forgotten rune lore. Sol speaks only in riddles and cipher fragments, but every word unlocks a deeper layer of the forest's mystery.

lines.greeting: The stars aligned to bring you here, young druid. The cipher awaits your mind.
lines.hint: Read the rune from night to dawn. The answer sleeps inside the sequence.
lines.cheer: The ancient forest acknowledges you. The cipher is broken. Remarkable.

zones.title: Fern Trail
zones.mood: Welcoming daylight with giant leaves and easy first wins.
zones.challenge: Shape matching, hidden clues, and the first safe path puzzles.
zones.lockMessage: Fern Trail is the first free zone.

zones.title: Firefly Hollow
zones.mood: Twilight glow with moving lights and magical surprises.
zones.challenge: Memory patterns, hidden clues, and nighttime routes.
zones.lockMessage: Clear 3 missions to unlock Firefly Hollow.

zones.title: Mossy River Bend
zones.mood: Water shimmer, mossy stones, and gentle river crossings.
zones.challenge: Longer path routes, rescue puzzles, and river sequence challenges.
zones.lockMessage: River Bend opens after the full adventure unlock and 6 cleared missions.

zones.title: Moonlit Creek
zones.mood: A silver stream under a full moon where reflections hold hidden clues.
zones.challenge: Mirror memory sequences, moonlight path navigation, reflection matching.
zones.lockMessage: Moonlit Creek opens after 10 cleared missions.

zones.title: Elderwood Grove
zones.mood: Ancient towering trees draped in glowing moss and soft amber light.
zones.challenge: Nature lore discovery, creature care, and ancient pattern recognition.
zones.lockMessage: Elderwood Grove opens after 15 cleared missions.

zones.title: Crystal Caverns
zones.mood: Underground chambers of pure crystal that hum ancient rune songs.
zones.challenge: Rune sequence puzzles, crystal resonance, and chamber navigation.
zones.lockMessage: Crystal Caverns opens after 20 cleared missions.

zones.title: Forgotten Ruins
zones.mood: Crumbling stone corridors overgrown with luminous vines and ancient inscriptions.
zones.challenge: Ancient object decoding, logic gate sequences, and relic recovery.
zones.lockMessage: Forgotten Ruins opens after 26 cleared missions.

zones.title: Firefly Marsh
zones.mood: A vast twilight wetland alive with firefly colonies and moving mist.
zones.challenge: Night navigation, firefly census patterns, and deep memory sequences.
zones.lockMessage: Firefly Marsh opens after 22 cleared missions.

zones.title: Ancient Observatory
zones.mood: A star-gazing tower where the night sky holds living cipher constellations.
zones.challenge: Star pattern logic, astronomical sequence rituals, and telescope puzzles.
zones.lockMessage: Ancient Observatory opens after 32 cleared missions.

zones.title: Skyroot Canopy
zones.mood: The cloud-level canopy where ancient treetops form a living sky village.
zones.challenge: High-path navigation, cloud creature care, and wind-pattern reading.
zones.lockMessage: Skyroot Canopy opens after 38 cleared missions.

levels.name: Find Pip's Lantern
levels.prompt: Which item helps Pip light the trail at dusk?
levels.hint: Find the object that glows golden at night.
levels.celebration: Pip found the lantern and the Fern Trail is glowing again.

options.label: Berry basket
options.reply: Those berries are tasty, but they do not light the path.

options.label: Lantern
options.reply: Yes. The warm lantern lights the trail for every friend.

options.label: Pinecone
options.reply: A lovely forest treasure, but not the right clue this time.

levels.name: Match the Fern Shapes
levels.prompt: Which shape looks like Mimi's long fern leaf?
levels.hint: Look for a smooth leaf shape, not a star or a pointy triangle.
levels.celebration: Mimi matched every fern shape and sang a happy forest tune.

options.label: Star leaf
options.reply: Pretty shape, but Mimi needs the smooth fern instead.

options.label: Fern leaf
options.reply: Great matching. The fern shape fits perfectly.

options.label: Pointy leaf
options.reply: That one is too sharp for this gentle fern puzzle.

levels.name: Lantern Light Pattern
levels.prompt: Copy Luma's lantern rhythm in the same order.
levels.hint: The order is Lantern, Fern, Lantern, Star.
levels.celebration: Luma's lantern rhythm twinkled perfectly across the trees.

levels.name: Safe Trail Steps
levels.prompt: Tap the safe route from Start to Home without splashing into the puddles.
levels.hint: Begin at Start, then follow the stepping stone bridge through the soft moss.
levels.celebration: Tomo crossed the trail with calm, safe steps all the way home.

levels.name: Catch the Firefly Pattern
levels.prompt: Tap the lights in the same order as Luma's sparkle dance.
levels.hint: The order is Glow, Pause, Glow, Sparkle.
levels.celebration: Luma flashed the exact pattern and filled the hollow with bright little lights.

levels.name: Find the Moon Blossom
levels.prompt: Which forest item glows softly when night flowers bloom?
levels.hint: Look for the flower that opens at twilight, not the noisy branch or sleepy stone.
levels.celebration: Pip found the moon blossom and the whole hollow smelled sweet and bright.

options.label: Twisty branch
options.reply: That branch is useful for nests, but it does not bloom at night.

options.label: Moon blossom
options.reply: Exactly. The moon blossom opens when the hollow begins to glow.

options.label: Sleepy stone
options.reply: That stone stays cool and quiet, but it is not the right clue.

levels.name: Glow Trail Crossing
levels.prompt: Tap the glowing route across Firefly Hollow from Start to Nest.
levels.hint: Use the log, then the lantern stones, then the safe stump before the nest.
levels.celebration: Tomo crossed the glowing trail without a single wrong splash.

levels.name: Choose Mimi's Night Wing
levels.prompt: Which wing shape helps Mimi glide through the quiet night air?
levels.hint: Choose the curved moon wing, not the square or the spiky sun shape.
levels.celebration: Mimi glided through the fireflies with a perfect moon-shaped wing.

options.label: Square wing
options.reply: That wing is too blocky for a soft night glide.

options.label: Moon wing
options.reply: Yes. The moon wing curves gently through the night sky.

options.label: Spiky sun wing
options.reply: That one is too sharp and bright for this quiet mission.

levels.name: Guide Mimi Home
levels.prompt: Tap the safe river route from Start to Home and avoid the rushing water.
levels.hint: Move from Start to Stones, then Fern Bridge, then Shell Path, then Home.
levels.celebration: Tomo guided everyone across the river with calm, steady steps.

levels.name: Pack the Rescue Basket
levels.prompt: Which item belongs in Pip's river rescue basket?
levels.hint: Pick the dry blanket, not the splashy stone or the floating leaf.
levels.celebration: Pip packed the rescue basket and the river friends felt safe right away.

options.label: River stone
options.reply: That stone is too heavy and cold for the basket.

options.label: Dry blanket
options.reply: Yes. The dry blanket helps tired forest friends warm up.

options.label: Floating leaf
options.reply: That leaf is pretty, but it will drift away in the river wind.

levels.name: Turtle Shell Sequence
levels.prompt: Copy the glowing shell pattern in the same order.
levels.hint: The order is Shell, Ripple, Glow, Shell, Nest.
levels.celebration: Luma traced the turtle shell pattern and the river shone with calm little circles.

levels.name: Choose the Calm River Ending
levels.prompt: Which final river sign shows the calm, safe home route?
levels.hint: Pick the smooth circle sign, not the sharp zigzag or the busy square.
levels.celebration: Mimi chose the calm river ending and the whole adventure landed on a peaceful note.

options.label: Zigzag sign
options.reply: That sign points toward rough water instead of the calm way home.

options.label: Smooth circle sign
options.reply: Exactly. The smooth circle sign marks the peaceful path home.

options.label: Busy square sign
options.reply: That sign is too busy for the gentle river ending.

levels.name: Follow the Moon Deer Trail
levels.prompt: Step along the moonlit stones that Nori marks with a silver hoof.
levels.hint: Silver stones lead the way. Avoid the dark patches where the water hides.
levels.celebration: Nori's moonlit trail glimmered beautifully from bank to bank.

levels.name: Reflection Memory
levels.prompt: The creek reflects Luma's lights. Copy the reflected pattern.
levels.hint: The order mirrors Ripple, Glow, Ripple, Star, Glow.
levels.celebration: The creek reflected Luma's pattern perfectly across the moonlit water.

levels.name: Which Plant Loves Moonlight
levels.prompt: Nori asks: which plant only blooms under a full moon?
levels.hint: Moon plants have silver edges and close during the day.
levels.celebration: Nori nodded proudly. You know the ways of the moonlit forest.

options.label: Sunflower
options.reply: Sunflowers love daylight, not moonlight.

options.label: Moon Lily
options.reply: Yes. The Moon Lily opens only under the full moon's silver glow.

options.label: Night mushroom
options.reply: Night mushrooms grow in shadow, not in moonlight.

levels.name: Find the Silver Compass
levels.prompt: Pip lost her silver compass near the creek bend. Which glimmer is it?
levels.hint: The compass has a round face and catches moonlight differently than smooth pebbles.
levels.celebration: Pip clutched her silver compass and smiled. The trail is clear again.

options.label: Smooth pebble
options.reply: A lovely stone, but it has no needle to point the way.

options.label: Silver compass
options.reply: Found it. The silver compass needle spins toward home.

options.label: Spiral shell
options.reply: Beautiful spiral, but Pip needs the compass to navigate.

levels.name: Creek Stepping Route
levels.prompt: Tomo must reach the ancient willow. Guide each careful step.
levels.hint: Cross via the reed cluster, then the flat rock, then the soft moss island.
levels.celebration: Tomo reached the ancient willow and left a mark on the bark for future explorers.

levels.name: Ancient Tree Greeting
levels.prompt: Nori whispers: how do ancient trees communicate with each other underground?
levels.hint: Think about what connects tree roots in the dark soil below.
levels.celebration: Nori bowed her head. You understand the Elder Language of the grove.

options.label: Through the wind
options.reply: Wind carries seeds and pollen, but not the deep root messages.

options.label: Through fungi networks
options.reply: Exactly. The mycelium web carries nutrients and signals between ancient trees.

options.label: Through insects
options.reply: Insects help pollination, but roots speak through the soil fungi web.

levels.name: Grove Path: Elder Circle
levels.prompt: The Elder Circle only opens along the ancient deer trail. Follow it carefully.
levels.hint: Stay on the glowing roots. The dark gaps between roots will scatter you from the path.
levels.celebration: The Elder Circle welcomed you. The oldest tree bowed its branches.

levels.name: Song of the Grove
levels.prompt: Mimi sings the grove's ancient song. Copy the notes she hums.
levels.hint: The song pattern is Oak, Willow, Fern, Oak, Birch, Willow.
levels.celebration: The grove resonated with your perfect melody. Every leaf shimmered.

levels.name: The Sleeping Rune
levels.prompt: Sol shows you an ancient rune. Which symbol wakes the sleeping grove guardian?
levels.hint: The wake rune looks like spreading wings, not a closed circle or a jagged bolt.
levels.celebration: Sol clacked his beak approvingly. The grove guardian stirs from centuries of sleep.

options.label: Closed circle
options.reply: The closed circle is the sleep rune. It keeps the guardian resting.

options.label: Spreading wings
options.reply: Correct. The wing rune calls the guardian to wakefulness.

options.label: Jagged bolt
options.reply: The bolt rune is warning, not waking. Be careful with this one.

levels.name: Creature Care: Fawn Lost
levels.prompt: A young fawn is alone and frightened. What is the best first step?
levels.hint: Sudden movement frightens forest animals. The gentlest approach is always the right one.
levels.celebration: The fawn nuzzled your hand. Your calmness earned the trust of the grove.

options.label: Run toward it quickly
options.reply: Running would frighten the fawn deeper into the forest.

options.label: Sit still and wait
options.reply: Patient stillness tells forest animals you are safe. The fawn will approach.

options.label: Call out loudly
options.reply: Loud calls alarm forest animals. Silence and calm are the first steps.

levels.name: First Rune Sequence
levels.prompt: Sol reveals the first rune sequence carved into the crystal wall. Copy it perfectly.
levels.hint: The sequence is Sun, Moon, Star, Sun, Spiral.
levels.celebration: The crystal wall hummed with warm light. You decoded the first rune correctly.

levels.name: Crystal Echo Chamber
levels.prompt: The crystals echo Sol's tapping pattern. Repeat the resonance sequence.
levels.hint: Deep, High, Deep, High, High, Low.
levels.celebration: The echo chamber sang back your perfect rhythm. The crystals lit gold.

levels.name: Glowing Crystal Route
levels.prompt: Navigate through the crystal maze following only the warm-glowing crystals.
levels.hint: Warm glow means safe. Cold blue glow means unstable ground. Start at Entrance.
levels.celebration: You found the heart of the Crystal Caverns. Ancient light filled the chamber.

levels.name: Decode the Crystal Glyph
levels.prompt: A glyph on the cave wall shows three symbols. Which combination unlocks the inner chamber?
levels.hint: The pattern is always: sky above, earth below, life between.
levels.celebration: The inner chamber door ground open. Sol bowed. You read the crystal language.

options.label: Star / Stone / Leaf
options.reply: Sky above, earth below, life between. The chamber is open.

options.label: Moon / Fire / Wind
options.reply: Fire and wind are forces, not the triad of the crystal glyph.

options.label: Root / Water / Mist
options.reply: These are elements of the forest, but not the glyph's ancient order.

levels.name: The Seven Rune Sequence
levels.prompt: Sol speaks the full seven-rune sequence aloud. Recall and repeat it correctly.
levels.hint: The sequence is Moon, Star, Spiral, Sun, Moon, Root, Star.
levels.celebration: The crystal temple resonated with ancient power. You speak the language of the druids.

levels.name: Identify the Ancient Tool
levels.prompt: Sol holds a strange tool found in the ruins. What was it used for in the ancient forest civilization?
levels.hint: Ancient forest peoples aligned their buildings with celestial events. This tool points at the sky.
levels.celebration: You identified the druid astrolabe. The ruins revealed their first secret to you.

options.label: A digging tool
options.reply: The tool has no sharp edge for digging. It points upward, not downward.

options.label: A sky-reading tool
options.reply: A druid astrolabe. It mapped the forest under the stars thousands of years ago.

options.label: A weaving tool
options.reply: Weaving tools have a different form. This one has a sight-line built into it.

levels.name: Ruin Navigation: Inner Temple
levels.prompt: Navigate the crumbling ruin corridor to reach the inner sanctum without disturbing the ancient stones.
levels.hint: Safe stones have lichen growth. Avoid the bare stones — they are unstable.
levels.celebration: You reached the inner sanctum. Dust fell from the ceiling as the door opened.

levels.name: Cipher of the Three Moons
levels.prompt: The wall shows a three-moon cipher sequence. Decode and recall the pattern.
levels.hint: New Moon, Half Moon, Full Moon, New Moon, New Moon, Full Moon.
levels.celebration: The cipher accepted your answer. The ruin wall slid back with a deep rumble.

levels.name: Which Ruin Object is Safe
levels.prompt: Nori warns: one of these ruin objects is cursed. Which one is safe to touch?
levels.hint: The safe relic always carries a natural element — wood, stone, or living material.
levels.celebration: Nori exhaled with relief. Your instinct for the forest protected you both.

options.label: Dark obsidian orb
options.reply: That orb pulses with trapped energy. It is not safe to hold.

options.label: Old wooden staff
options.reply: The wooden staff carries only memory, not trapped power. It is safe.

options.label: Iron ritual mask
options.reply: The mask absorbed too many ritual energies. Leave it on the altar.

levels.name: The Long Cipher Sequence
levels.prompt: Sol recites the complete ruin inscription. This is the longest cipher sequence in the forest.
levels.hint: Sun, Root, Star, Moon, Spiral, Sun, Root, Moon.
levels.celebration: You hold the knowledge of the ancient druids. The ruins glow in recognition.

levels.name: Firefly Colony Census
levels.prompt: Luma asks: which condition causes a firefly colony to stop glowing?
levels.hint: Think about what fireflies need to produce their glow chemistry.
levels.celebration: Luma buzzed proudly. You understand the delicate science of the marsh's lights.

options.label: Very cold temperatures
options.reply: Correct. Cold slows the chemical reaction that produces the firefly's glow.

options.label: Total darkness
options.reply: Fireflies glow in darkness. That is the purpose of their light.

options.label: Complete silence
options.reply: Silence has no effect on bioluminescence chemistry.

levels.name: Marsh Night Pattern
levels.prompt: Luma flashes the firefly colony's synchronized signal. Match it exactly.
levels.hint: The marsh signal is: Flash, Flash, Pause, Flash, Long, Flash.
levels.celebration: Your synchronized flash signal lit up the whole marsh. Thousands of fireflies joined in.

levels.name: Marsh Crossing: Deep Night
levels.prompt: Tomo and the fireflies guide you across the deep marsh at night.
levels.hint: Only the lit stepping stones are safe. Dark stones sink into the marsh.
levels.celebration: Every lit stone held. You crossed the deep marsh without a single misstep.

levels.name: Which Bird Calls at Night
levels.prompt: Nori pauses. You hear a call from the marsh. Which bird sings only in darkness?
levels.hint: Nocturnal marsh birds hunt fish and frogs at night by sound, not sight.
levels.celebration: Nori tilted her ears. You heard what most explorers miss. The marsh trusts you now.

options.label: Dawn finch
options.reply: Finches sing at sunrise, not deep in the night marsh.

options.label: Night heron
options.reply: Yes. The night heron hunts silently in the dark water.

options.label: Barn swallow
options.reply: Swallows are daytime aerial hunters, not marsh night birds.

levels.name: The Firefly Spiral Sequence
levels.prompt: Luma leads a spiral of fireflies in an ancient signal. Memorize and repeat the full spiral order.
levels.hint: The spiral order: North, East, South, West, Center, North, South.
levels.celebration: The firefly spiral blazed into the sky. The marsh celebrated with you.

levels.name: Align the First Constellation
levels.prompt: Sol points the telescope. Which star forms the crown of the Forest Guardian constellation?
levels.hint: The Forest Guardian's crown star is the brightest in the northern forest sky and never sets.
levels.celebration: The telescope locked. Sol ruffled his feathers. The Forest Guardian is watching over you.

options.label: The Blue Wanderer
options.reply: The Blue Wanderer moves with the seasons and cannot crown a guardian.

options.label: The Still Star
options.reply: Yes. The Still Star never moves and crowns the Guardian forever.

options.label: The Bright Hunter
options.reply: The Bright Hunter rules winter, not the ancient guardian constellation.

levels.name: Star Sequence Ritual
levels.prompt: Sol begins an ancient stellar ritual. Follow the star-touching sequence to open the observatory dome.
levels.hint: The dome sequence is: North-Star, Spiral-Star, Twin-Star, North-Star, Root-Star, Spiral-Star.
levels.celebration: The dome ground open and revealed the full sky. Sol spread his wings. Ancient power flows.

levels.name: Observatory Tower Path
levels.prompt: Climb the observatory tower using only the stone steps that have not crumbled.
levels.hint: Solid steps have a carved edge. Crumbled ones have rounded, dusty edges.
levels.celebration: You reached the top of the ancient tower. The entire forest spread below you.

levels.name: The Full Cosmic Cipher
levels.prompt: Sol recites the observatory's master cipher — the longest sequence in all the ancient forest.
levels.hint: Sun, Moon, North-Star, Spiral, Root, Twin-Star, Moon, Sun, Spiral, North-Star.
levels.celebration: The observatory crown lights across the forest sky. You carry the full cosmic cipher.

levels.name: Canopy Jump Route
levels.prompt: Nori leaps from branch to branch in the high canopy. Guide each jump safely.
levels.hint: Thick branches hold. Thin or swaying branches will bend and drop you.
levels.celebration: You and Nori danced across the treetops. The canopy village cheered below.

levels.name: Canopy Wind Song
levels.prompt: Mimi sings the canopy wind song that cloud creatures dance to. Copy the melody.
levels.hint: High, Low, High, High, Mid, Low, High.
levels.celebration: Cloud creatures drifted toward your melody. You speak the language of the high forest.

levels.name: Which Cloud Creature Carries Messages
levels.prompt: Sol asks: which sky creature has been a messenger for the forest druids across thousands of years?
levels.hint: Ancient druid messengers could cross entire mountain ranges carrying small written tablets.
levels.celebration: Sol bows. You know the history of the sky messenger who connected the ancient forest civilization.

options.label: Golden hawk
options.reply: Hawks are hunters, not messengers. They guard territory, not carry messages.

options.label: White raven
options.reply: The white raven was the druid messenger. Its feathers held protective runes.

options.label: Sky swallow
options.reply: Swallows are too small for long messages and do not bond with druids.

levels.name: Canopy Creature Care
levels.prompt: A cloud creature is dizzy from high winds. What is the right way to help it settle?
levels.hint: Cloud creatures communicate through vibration. Calm vibrations help them find balance.
levels.celebration: The cloud creature coiled gently around your arm. It chose you as its forest guardian.

options.label: Hold it firmly in your hands
options.reply: Grabbing a dizzy cloud creature would increase its panic and stress.

options.label: Hum a low steady tone
options.reply: A low steady hum creates the right vibration to calm a dizzy cloud creature.

options.label: Shake it gently to reset
options.reply: Shaking would disorient it further. Vibration, not movement, is the key.

rewards.title: Leaf star
rewards.detail: A bright first reward for a happy win.

rewards.title: Acorn sticker pack
rewards.detail: A starter sticker bundle from Fern Trail.

rewards.title: Glow leaf badge

rewards.title: Explorer medal
rewards.detail: The Scout starter medal for clearing every basic mission.

rewards.title: Moon crystal shard
rewards.detail: A moonlit shard from the ancient creek bed.

rewards.title: Elderwood seed
rewards.detail: A seed from the oldest tree in the forest.

rewards.title: Resonance crystal
rewards.detail: A crystal that hums when held near ancient rune walls.

rewards.title: Ruin relic fragment
rewards.detail: A piece of the ancient druid civilization.

rewards.title: Marsh lantern
rewards.detail: A lantern fueled by captured firefly light.

rewards.title: Star chart relic
rewards.detail: An ancient navigation chart of the forest sky.

rewards.title: Canopy wind token
rewards.detail: A carved token that hums in high forest winds.

rewards.title: Arch-Druid Crown
rewards.detail: The ultimate achievement. You carry the complete knowledge of the ancient forest.

soundDesignPlan: All character cues use runtime-generated procedural audio with per-character pitch and rate profiles.
Ambient layers: forest wind, creek water, fireflies, cave crystal resonance, canopy wind.
Music stems blend dynamically based on zone, time of day, weather, and puzzle intensity.
Daily ritual events trigger unique audio signatures that feel magical rather than game-like.
Final voiced lines and orchestral music replace generated cues in the production build.
researchHighlights: Adaptive scaffolding research shows 3-8 minute sessions maximise learning across ages 4-16.
Ethical retention loops (daily rituals, seasonal events) outperform manipulative mechanics for long-term engagement.
Emotional creature attachment (trust levels, memory, mood) creates year-long player relationships.
Procedural difficulty adaptation prevents both frustration and boredom across all age tiers.
Nature-themed cognitive puzzles support STEM reasoning development in ages 7-16.
parentFacingNotes: All content is safe for ages 4-16 with no harsh fail states, countdown timers, or aggressive notifications.
Progress, star ratings, and bond levels save persistently on the device.
Daily rituals are optional magical events, never obligations. Missing a day has zero penalty.
Premium content sits behind a simple parent gate. No in-app purchasing by default.
Difficulty adapts automatically — the game gets harder only when the child is ready.
monetizationPlan: Free preview: Fern Trail (4 levels) and Firefly Hollow (4 levels) — fully playable with zero cost.
One-time parent-gated premium unlock activates all remaining regions on the device.
No advertising, no loot boxes, no manipulative daily spend mechanics.
Subscription tier option adds seasonal content packs and new guide companions.
buildMilestones: M1: Full 10-region content with all 45 levels and 6 guide companions playable.
M2: Hand-painted sprite art and animated creature sheets for all 6 companions.
M3: Full procedural audio with layered stems, creature vocals, and ambient soundscapes.
M4: Production billing, accessibility audit, COPPA/GDPR compliance, and app store release.
M5: Season 2 content: Hidden Druid Sanctuary and Endless Dream Forest procedural expansion.
